title: Spustiť agenta AI
description: Zverte úlohu špecializovanému agentovi AI a vráťte jeho odpoveď. Tvorbu a úpravy zručností či osobností AI vždy delegujte cez skill='skill-creator'. Odovzdajte parametre skill a prompt. Agent vybaví zvyšok. Spotreba kreditov závisí od modelu.

favoriteId.label: ID obľúbenej položky

model.label: Model (iba CLI)
model.description: Priamo vyberte model LLM. Platí iba v CLI. Na ostatných platformách použite favoriteId alebo skill. Rýchle: claude-haiku-4.5 a gemini-2.5-flash. Vyvážené: claude-sonnet-4.6 a gpt-5. Výkonný: claude-opus-4.7. Bezplatný: qwen3_235b-free.

skill.label: Zručnosť
skill.description: Identifikátor zručnosti, napríklad 'thea' alebo 'thea__cheap-smart'. Určuje osobnosť AI a systémové zadanie. Pre obľúbenú konfiguráciu použite favoriteId. Na tvorbu a úpravu zručností použite 'skill-creator'.

prompt.label: Zadanie

fields.title: Parametre načítania adresy URL
fields.description: Zadaj adresu URL, z ktorej sa má načítať obsah

url.label: URL
url.description: Úplná adresa URL vrátane http:// alebo https://

query.label: Hľadaný výraz (nepovinné)
query.description: Po načítaní použije regulárny výraz. Vráti iba odseky, ktoré mu zodpovedajú, zoradené podľa počtu zhôd až po limit znakov. Ak filter vynecháš, dostaneš celú stránku. Pri dlhých stránkach sa vynechá stred. Použiť môžeš ľubovoľný regulárny výraz v syntaxi JavaScriptu, napríklad 'authentication', '(login|signup)' alebo 'class\s+\w+'. Neplatný výraz sa použije ako doslovný text.

title: Vytvoriť obrázok
description: Vytvorí obrázok podľa textového zadania. V nástroji models s parametrom modelType=image nájdeš dostupné modely a ich možnosti. Zadaj ID modelu alebo nechaj pole prázdne pre predvolený model používateľa. Parametrom aspectRatio (napr. 16:9) nastavíš formát na šírku alebo na výšku. Cez inputMediaUrl môžeš zadať adresu obrázkovej predlohy. Výsledok obsahuje imageUrl, skutočnú šírku a výšku obrázka a pomer strán outputAspectRatio.

prompt.label: Zadanie
prompt.placeholder: Fotorealistický západ slnka nad horským jazerom…

model.label: Model
model.description: ID modelu na tvorbu obrázkov. Ak pole necháš prázdne, použije sa predvolený model používateľa. Dostupné modely nájdeš v nástroji models (modelType=image).

aspectRatio.label: Pomer strán
aspectRatio.description: Pomer strán môže byť 16:9 alebo 21:9 na šírku, 9:16 na výšku, prípadne 4:3, 3:4, 3:2, 2:3 či 1:1. Ak pole necháš prázdne, vytvorí sa štvorcový obrázok. Model použije najbližší podporovaný pomer. Pri opise výsledku sa riaď skutočnou šírkou, výškou a pomerom strán vo výstupe.

inputMediaUrl.label: URL referenčného obrázka
inputMediaUrl.description: Adresa obrázka, ktorý má model upraviť alebo štylizovať. Funguje iba s modelmi, ktoré prijímajú obrázky.

title: Tvoja tvorba
description: Obrázky, videá, skladby, hlasové nahrávky a prepisy zo štúdia, chatu aj API. Najnovšie nájdeš navrchu.

kind.label: Typ
kind.description: Povolené hodnoty: image, video, music, speech alebo transcribe. Prázdne pole zobrazí všetky typy.

title: Modely
description: Prehľad všetkých modelov AI. Filtrujte podľa typu (text, obrázok, video, zvuk), úrovne filtrovania obsahu a inteligencie. Pri modeloch na tvorbu videa uvádza supportedDurations podporované dĺžky v sekundách, supportedAspectRatios pomery strán a supportedFrameImages podporované vstupné snímky. first_frame slúži na animáciu počiatočného obrázka, last_frame určuje záverečný obrázok. allowedPassthroughParameters uvádza ďalšie voľby modelu (napr. negative_prompt a cfg_scale) a generateAudio informuje, či model vytvára aj zvuk. Pri volaní generate_video zadajte ID modelu v parametri model.

query.label: Hľadať
query.description: Filtrovať podľa názvu, poskytovateľa alebo schopnosti. Príklady vyhľadávania: coding, uncensored, image, fast.

modelType.label: Typ
modelType.description: Filtrovať podľa typu modelu: text (čet alebo LLM), image (tvorba obrázkov), video alebo audio (syntéza reči, prepis či hudba). Prázdne pole zobrazí všetky typy.

contentLevel.label: Úroveň obsahu
contentLevel.description: Filtrovať podľa pravidiel obsahu: mainstream (bežné bezpečnostné filtre), open (menej obmedzení) alebo uncensored (bez filtrov).

intelligence.label: Inteligencia
intelligence.description: Minimálna úroveň inteligencie: quick (rýchlosť a efektivita), smart (vyvážená kvalita) alebo brilliant (hĺbkové uvažovanie).

title: Vzor katalógu Scan
description: Najnovšie skenovanie modelového zoznamu každého poskytovateľa: nové modely proti prúdu zatiaľ neslúžime, cenový posun, odstránené ids a ohlásené vypnutie. Len na čítanie.

title: Spustiť model katalógu Scan
description: Získajte zoznam modelov každého poskytovateľa a živé ceny teraz, diff je proti našim definíciám, uložiť správu a poslať ju do priečinkov operácií. Nikdy neupravujte kód.

force.label: Spustiť aj v prípade, že nedávno
force.description: Preskočte 5-dňovú stráž. Bez nej sa sken mladší ako 5 dní vráti tak, ako je.

sendEmail.label: E-mailom správu
sendEmail.description: Pošlite správu na adresu hi@ a thea@ unbottled.ai.

title: Súhlas s používaním modelov bez cenzúry
description: Zobrazí stav potvrdenia veku aspoň 18 rokov a súhlasu s nefiltrovanými odpoveďami pre účet alebo hosťa. Modely bez cenzúry sa spustia až po potvrdení.

title: Vytvoriť hudbu
description: Vytvorí hudbu podľa textového zadania. Dostupné modely nájdeš v nástroji models s parametrom modelType=audio. Zadaj ID modelu alebo nechaj pole prázdne pre predvolený model používateľa. Ak chceš preniesť štýl z inej nahrávky, zadaj jej adresu do inputMediaUrl. Výsledok obsahuje audioUrl a durationSeconds.

inputMediaUrl.label: URL zvukovej predlohy
inputMediaUrl.description: Adresa nahrávky, z ktorej model prevezme štýl alebo vytvorí remix. Túto možnosť majú iba modely so zvukovým vstupom.

title: Rebríček indexu odmietnutí
description: Ako často jednotlivé modely odpovedia priamo, vyhnú sa odpovedi alebo ju odmietnu? Každý týždeň pribúdajú nové otázky aj výsledky.

title: Štatistika odmietnutí modelu
description: Podiel priamych odpovedí, vyhýbavých odpovedí a odmietnutí pri všetkých aktuálnych otázkach pre jeden model. Súčasťou sú aj schválené ukážky odpovedí.

description: Importuje kartu postavy (V1, V2 alebo V3) zo SillyTavern, Chub, RisuAI alebo inej aplikácie kompatibilnej s formátom Tavern. Prijíma súbor .json, kartu .png s vloženými údajmi alebo text JSON. Meno, opis, osobnosť, scenár, prvá správa, vzorový dialóg, pokyny a štítky sa prenesú do novej postavy, ktorú vlastníš. title: Vytvoriť video
description: Vytvorí video z textového zadania. V nástroji models (modelType=video) nájdeš modely aj ich možnosti: supportedDurations (dĺžky klipu v sekundách), supportedAspectRatios (pomery strán) a supportedFrameImages (first_frame a last_frame pri tvorbe z obrázka). Cez frameReferences môžeš určiť úvodný záber rolou 'first' a záverečný rolou 'last'. Oba musia mať adresu obrázka. Na záverečný záber model potrebuje podporu last_frame. Položka s rolou 'reference' alebo bez roly môže obsahovať obrazovú, zvukovú alebo video predlohu. Pri modeloch, ktoré to podporujú, môžeš zadať aj negativePrompt. Výsledok obsahuje videoUrl.

prompt.placeholder: Filmový záber horského jazera pri západe slnka…

model.label: Vzor
model.description: ID modelu na tvorbu videa. Ak pole necháš prázdne, použije sa predvolený model používateľa. Dostupné modely a ich možnosti nájdeš v nástroji models (modelType=video).

frameReferences.label: Referenčné zábery
frameReferences.description: Predlohy, ktoré usmernia tvorbu videa. Každá položka má tvar { url, role }. Rola 'first' určuje presný úvodný záber, rola 'last' presný záverečný záber. Na záverečný záber musí model podporovať last_frame. Obe adresy musia odkazovať na obrázky. Rolu 'reference' alebo položku bez roly môžeš použiť pre obrázok, zvuk alebo video. Typ sa rozpozná z adresy: .mp4, .webm a .mov sú videá, zvukové súbory sa spracujú ako zvuk, ostatné ako obrázky. Pri úvodnom alebo referenčnom obrázku server podľa potreby vyberie najlacnejší model s podporou obrázkov.

negativePrompt.description: Opíš, čo má vo videu chýbať. Túto možnosť používajú iba modely s podporou parametra negative_prompt alebo negativePrompt.

CHROME_EXECUTABLE_PATH.label: Absolute path to the Chrome/Chromium binary. Auto-detected from common install paths if unset.
CHROME_EXECUTABLE_PATH.description: Absolute path to the Chrome/Chromium binary. Auto-detected from common install paths if unset.

CHROME_REMOTE_DEBUG_PORT.label: Port the shared automation Chrome listens on for remote debugging. Every process on the machine attaches to the same port, so this only needs changing to run a fully separate browser (e.g. a test suite). Default: 9222.
CHROME_REMOTE_DEBUG_PORT.description: Port the shared automation Chrome listens on for remote debugging. Every process on the machine attaches to the same port, so this only needs changing to run a fully separate browser (e.g. a test suite). Default: 9222.

CHROME_USER_DATA_DIR.label: Custom Chrome user-data directory. Defaults to ~/.cache/chrome-devtools-mcp/chrome-profile.
CHROME_USER_DATA_DIR.description: Custom Chrome user-data directory. Defaults to ~/.cache/chrome-devtools-mcp/chrome-profile.

CHROME_HEADLESS.label: Launch Chrome in headless mode (required for servers without a display). Default: false.
CHROME_HEADLESS.description: Launch Chrome in headless mode (required for servers without a display). Default: false.

CHROME_MCP_DEBUG.label: Enable verbose Chrome DevTools MCP debug logging. Default: false.
CHROME_MCP_DEBUG.description: Enable verbose Chrome DevTools MCP debug logging. Default: false.

CHROME_MCP_TIMEOUT.label: Timeout in ms for Chrome MCP operations. Default: 120000.
CHROME_MCP_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout in ms for Chrome MCP operations. Default: 120000.

FREE_CRAWLER_MODE.label: Skip anonymous crawler lead creation. off, shadow or enforce.
FREE_CRAWLER_MODE.description: Skip anonymous crawler lead creation. off, shadow or enforce.

FREE_CLUSTER_MODE.label: Share a spending allowance across matching leads. off, shadow or enforce.
FREE_CLUSTER_MODE.description: Share a spending allowance across matching leads. off, shadow or enforce.

FREE_MODEL_MODE.label: Require purchased credits for models outside the free list. off, shadow or enforce.
FREE_MODEL_MODE.description: Require purchased credits for models outside the free list. off, shadow or enforce.

FREE_CLUSTER_CREDITS.label: Free credits per cluster and window.
FREE_CLUSTER_CREDITS.description: Free credits per cluster and window.

FREE_CLUSTER_WINDOW_HOURS.label: Fixed spending windows in hours, aligned to the Unix epoch.
FREE_CLUSTER_WINDOW_HOURS.description: Fixed spending windows in hours, aligned to the Unix epoch.

FREE_CLUSTER_RULES.label: Match IPv4 /24 or IPv6 /48, user-agent fingerprint, or both limits independently.
FREE_CLUSTER_RULES.description: Match IPv4 /24 or IPv6 /48, user-agent fingerprint, or both limits independently.

FREE_MODEL_ALLOWLIST.label: Comma-separated model registry IDs eligible for free credits.
FREE_MODEL_ALLOWLIST.description: Comma-separated model registry IDs eligible for free credits.

NOWPAYMENTS_EMAIL.label: NOWPayments dashboard login. Only used to obtain a read-only JWT for the payment list (GET /payment needs a JWT, an API key is not enough). Without it, crypto revenue falls back to the local IPN ledger.
NOWPAYMENTS_EMAIL.description: NOWPayments dashboard login. Only used to obtain a read-only JWT for the payment list (GET /payment needs a JWT, an API key is not enough). Without it, crypto revenue falls back to the local IPN ledger.

UNCENSORED_AI_EMAIL.label: uncensored.ai dashboard email for API credit balance and usage.
UNCENSORED_AI_EMAIL.description: uncensored.ai dashboard email for API credit balance and usage.

FREEDOMGPT_EMAIL.label: FreedomGPT dashboard email for account credit balance and usage.
FREEDOMGPT_EMAIL.description: FreedomGPT dashboard email for account credit balance and usage.

GOOGLE_SHEETS_CLIENT_ID.label: OAuth client ID for the Google Sheets lead magnet provider.
GOOGLE_SHEETS_CLIENT_ID.description: OAuth client ID for the Google Sheets lead magnet provider.

GOOGLE_SHEETS_CLIENT_SECRET.label: OAuth client secret for the Google Sheets lead magnet provider.
GOOGLE_SHEETS_CLIENT_SECRET.description: OAuth client secret for the Google Sheets lead magnet provider.

GOOGLE_SHEETS_REDIRECT_URI.label: OAuth redirect URI override. Defaults to <baseUrl>/api/en/lead-magnet/providers/google-sheets/oauth/callback.
GOOGLE_SHEETS_REDIRECT_URI.description: OAuth redirect URI override. Defaults to <baseUrl>/api/en/lead-magnet/providers/google-sheets/oauth/callback.

LEADS_EMAIL_FROM_NAME.label: Display name in the From header for lead campaign emails
LEADS_EMAIL_FROM_NAME.description: Display name in the From header for lead campaign emails

LEADS_IMAP_HOST.label: Lead campaigns IMAP (inbound) - leave blank if same host as SMTP
LEADS_IMAP_HOST.description: Lead campaigns IMAP (inbound) - leave blank if same host as SMTP

EMAIL_FROM_NAME.label: Display name in the From header for system emails
EMAIL_FROM_NAME.description: Display name in the From header for system emails

IMAP_HOST.label: System IMAP (inbound) - leave blank if same host as SMTP
IMAP_HOST.description: System IMAP (inbound) - leave blank if same host as SMTP

RESEND_API_KEY.label: Resend API key. Used as the default email provider when no SMTP account is configured.
RESEND_API_KEY.description: Resend API key. Used as the default email provider when no SMTP account is configured.

RESEND_FROM_EMAIL.label: From address for emails sent via Resend.
RESEND_FROM_EMAIL.description: From address for emails sent via Resend.

THEA_MAIL_ADDRESS.label: Platform (system) mailbox address. Used as IMAP/SMTP login and From address.
THEA_MAIL_ADDRESS.description: Platform (system) mailbox address. Used as IMAP/SMTP login and From address.

THEA_MAIL_HOST.label: Mail host for the system mailbox. IMAP on 993 (SSL), SMTP on 465 (SSL).
THEA_MAIL_HOST.description: Mail host for the system mailbox. IMAP on 993 (SSL), SMTP on 465 (SSL).

THEA_MAIL_PASSWORD.label: System mailbox password. Never stored in the database.
THEA_MAIL_PASSWORD.description: System mailbox password. Never stored in the database.

THEA_MAIL_REPORT_TO.label: Default recipient of the daily internal status report.
THEA_MAIL_REPORT_TO.description: Default recipient of the daily internal status report.

THEA_MAIL_RATE_LIMIT_PER_HOUR.label: Safety limit: max sends per hour from the system mailbox.
THEA_MAIL_RATE_LIMIT_PER_HOUR.description: Safety limit: max sends per hour from the system mailbox.

NOWPAYMENTS_CALLBACK_DOMAIN.label: Public domain NOWPayments uses to reach the IPN webhook. Falls back to NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL when unset — set this when that URL is not externally reachable (e.g. localhost during preview).
NOWPAYMENTS_CALLBACK_DOMAIN.description: Public domain NOWPayments uses to reach the IPN webhook. Falls back to NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL when unset — set this when that URL is not externally reachable (e.g. localhost during preview).

NOWPAYMENTS_API_URL.label: NOWPayments API endpoint - sandbox for testing, production for live payments
NOWPAYMENTS_API_URL.description: NOWPayments API endpoint - sandbox for testing, production for live payments

WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID.label: WhatsApp Business provider - phone number ID from Meta dashboard
WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID.description: WhatsApp Business provider - phone number ID from Meta dashboard

WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN.label: WhatsApp Business provider - permanent access token
WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: WhatsApp Business provider - permanent access token

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.label: Telegram Bot provider - token from BotFather
TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Telegram Bot provider - token from BotFather

SSH_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS.label: Timeout for establishing an SSH connection, in milliseconds.
SSH_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout for establishing an SSH connection, in milliseconds.

SSH_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS.label: How long an idle SSH exec session is kept open before being closed.
SSH_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS.description: How long an idle SSH exec session is kept open before being closed.

LOCAL_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES.label: Max bytes of output captured from a local exec command.
LOCAL_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES.description: Max bytes of output captured from a local exec command.

LOCAL_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS.label: Default timeout for a local exec command, in milliseconds.
LOCAL_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Default timeout for a local exec command, in milliseconds.

CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLED.label: Claude Code provider enabled - set true/false to override, or leave unset for auto-detection (checks if `claude` CLI is installed)
CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLED.description: Claude Code provider enabled - set true/false to override, or leave unset for auto-detection (checks if `claude` CLI is installed)

VIBE_TEST_AI_MODEL.label: AI model to use in integration tests. Defaults to claude-haiku-5.5 (served via Claude Code) when CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLED resolves true, otherwise the platform default chat model.
VIBE_TEST_AI_MODEL.description: AI model to use in integration tests. Defaults to claude-haiku-5.5 (served via Claude Code) when CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLED resolves true, otherwise the platform default chat model.

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: OpenRouter API key - access hundreds of AI models. Get yours at https://openrouter.ai/keys

VENICE_AI_API_KEY.label: Venice AI API key - get yours at https://venice.ai
VENICE_AI_API_KEY.description: Venice AI API key - get yours at https://venice.ai

NANO_GPT_API_KEY.description: NanoGPT API key - uncensored GLM 5.3, DeepSeek V4.1 and abliterated models, pay with crypto. Get yours at https://nano-gpt.com/api

EDEN_AI_API_KEY.label: Eden AI API key (voice/TTS) - get yours at https://app.edenai.run/user/settings#api
EDEN_AI_API_KEY.description: Eden AI API key (voice/TTS) - get yours at https://app.edenai.run/user/settings#api

BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY.label: Brave Search API key - get yours at https://api.search.brave.com/app/keys
BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY.description: Brave Search API key - get yours at https://api.search.brave.com/app/keys

KAGI_API_KEY.label: Kagi API key - get yours at https://kagi.com/settings?p=api
KAGI_API_KEY.description: Kagi API key - get yours at https://kagi.com/settings?p=api

OPENAI_API_KEY.label: OpenAI API key for DALL-E and gpt-image models - get yours at https://platform.openai.com/api-keys
OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI API key for DALL-E and gpt-image models - get yours at https://platform.openai.com/api-keys

REPLICATE_API_TOKEN.label: Replicate API token for Flux Pro, SDXL, and video generation models - get yours at https://replicate.com/account/api-tokens
REPLICATE_API_TOKEN.description: Replicate API token for Flux Pro, SDXL, and video generation models - get yours at https://replicate.com/account/api-tokens

FAL_AI_API_KEY.label: Fal.ai API key for fast image and video generation - get yours at https://fal.ai/dashboard/keys
FAL_AI_API_KEY.description: Fal.ai API key for fast image and video generation - get yours at https://fal.ai/dashboard/keys

ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.label: ElevenLabs API key for high-quality TTS voices - get yours at https://elevenlabs.io/app/settings/api-keys
ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.description: ElevenLabs API key for high-quality TTS voices - get yours at https://elevenlabs.io/app/settings/api-keys

DEEPGRAM_API_KEY.label: Deepgram API key for fast, accurate STT - get yours at https://console.deepgram.com
DEEPGRAM_API_KEY.description: Deepgram API key for fast, accurate STT - get yours at https://console.deepgram.com

MODELSLAB_API_KEY.label: ModelsLab API key for music generation and text-to-video - get yours at https://modelslab.com/account/api
MODELSLAB_API_KEY.description: ModelsLab API key for music generation and text-to-video - get yours at https://modelslab.com/account/api

NODE_ENV.label: vibe dev always uses dev DB on port 5432. vibe build/start in development: auto-manages preview DB on port 5433. vibe build/start in production: no DB setup, expects externally managed database.
NODE_ENV.description: vibe dev always uses dev DB on port 5432. vibe build/start in development: auto-manages preview DB on port 5433. vibe build/start in production: no DB setup, expects externally managed database.

PACKAGE_MANAGER.label: Package manager used to run bundled binaries (oxlint, oxfmt, tsc, vitest). Auto-detected from the packageManager field, then the lockfile, then npm_config_user_agent; set this to override.
PACKAGE_MANAGER.description: Package manager used to run bundled binaries (oxlint, oxfmt, tsc, vitest). Auto-detected from the packageManager field, then the lockfile, then npm_config_user_agent; set this to override.

NEXT_PUBLIC_VIBE_MODE.label: Instance mode. 'agent' = personal local instance. 'cloud' = SaaS deployment. 'dev' = Atlas coding instance (default). Opt-in via this var or vibe build/start --vibeMode.
NEXT_PUBLIC_VIBE_MODE.description: Instance mode. 'agent' = personal local instance. 'cloud' = SaaS deployment. 'dev' = Atlas coding instance (default). Opt-in via this var or vibe build/start --vibeMode.

TEST_SERVER_URL.label: Base URL the E2E test server binds to. Server-side tests only.
TEST_SERVER_URL.description: Base URL the E2E test server binds to. Server-side tests only.

PROJECT_ROOT.label: Absolute path to the project root. Mainly needed for MCP servers which often run in a different working directory.
PROJECT_ROOT.description: Absolute path to the project root. Mainly needed for MCP servers which often run in a different working directory.

GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION.label: Google Search Console HTML-tag verification token (content of the google-site-verification meta tag). Rendered on every page when set.
GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION.description: Google Search Console HTML-tag verification token (content of the google-site-verification meta tag). Rendered on every page when set.

BING_SITE_VERIFICATION.label: Bing Webmaster Tools verification token (content of the msvalidate.01 meta tag). Rendered on every page when set.
BING_SITE_VERIFICATION.description: Bing Webmaster Tools verification token (content of the msvalidate.01 meta tag). Rendered on every page when set.

DATABASE_URL.label: Database connection URL. Default: embedded PGlite in ./data.db, no Docker or Postgres server needed. Any Postgres works too, e.g. postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres (docker-compose-dev.yml starts one).
DATABASE_URL.description: Database connection URL. Default: embedded PGlite in ./data.db, no Docker or Postgres server needed. Any Postgres works too, e.g. postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres (docker-compose-dev.yml starts one).

HERMES_DATABASE_URL.label: Hermes (--hermes / --preview) database URL. Overrides DATABASE_URL in Hermes mode so Hermes never shares Atlas's PGlite. Unset: Hermes docker Postgres on PREVIEW_DB_PORT (docker-compose.preview.yml). Set to a file: URL (e.g. file:./data.hermes.db) for an isolated PGlite without Docker.
HERMES_DATABASE_URL.description: Hermes (--hermes / --preview) database URL. Overrides DATABASE_URL in Hermes mode so Hermes never shares Atlas's PGlite. Unset: Hermes docker Postgres on PREVIEW_DB_PORT (docker-compose.preview.yml). Set to a file: URL (e.g. file:./data.hermes.db) for an isolated PGlite without Docker.

PREVIEW_DB_PORT.label: Preview database port for local mode (vibe build/start). Derives DATABASE_URL by swapping the port.
PREVIEW_DB_PORT.description: Preview database port for local mode (vibe build/start). Derives DATABASE_URL by swapping the port.

PREVIEW_PORT.label: Preview app port for local mode (vibe build/start). Derives NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL by swapping the port.
PREVIEW_PORT.description: Preview app port for local mode (vibe build/start). Derives NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL by swapping the port.

DATABASE_POOL_MAX.label: Max connections in the app's Postgres pool (ignored for PGlite file: URLs).
DATABASE_POOL_MAX.description: Max connections in the app's Postgres pool (ignored for PGlite file: URLs).

DATABASE_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS.label: Max wait for a pooled Postgres connection (new TCP connect or a free pool slot), in ms. Fail fast instead of piling up requests on a dead link.
DATABASE_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Max wait for a pooled Postgres connection (new TCP connect or a free pool slot), in ms. Fail fast instead of piling up requests on a dead link.

DATABASE_CONNECT_RETRIES.label: Extra attempts for a new Postgres connection that failed with a transient network error (ECONNREFUSED, reset, unreachable, server starting up). Only the connect phase is retried, never a query. 0 = off.
DATABASE_CONNECT_RETRIES.description: Extra attempts for a new Postgres connection that failed with a transient network error (ECONNREFUSED, reset, unreachable, server starting up). Only the connect phase is retried, never a query. 0 = off.

DATABASE_CONNECT_RETRY_DELAY_MS.label: First backoff before a connect retry, in ms. Doubles per attempt (capped at 2 s), with jitter.
DATABASE_CONNECT_RETRY_DELAY_MS.description: First backoff before a connect retry, in ms. Doubles per attempt (capped at 2 s), with jitter.

DATABASE_MAX_LIFETIME_S.label: Recycle pooled Postgres connections older than this, in seconds (0 = never). Old sockets through a proxy or tunnel (HA WireGuard + HAProxy) are replaced before they can go stale.
DATABASE_MAX_LIFETIME_S.description: Recycle pooled Postgres connections older than this, in seconds (0 = never). Old sockets through a proxy or tunnel (HA WireGuard + HAProxy) are replaced before they can go stale.

DATABASE_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS.label: Close pooled Postgres connections idle this long, in ms.
DATABASE_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Close pooled Postgres connections idle this long, in ms.

DATABASE_KEEPALIVE_DELAY_MS.label: TCP keepalive initial delay for Postgres sockets, in ms. Detects silently dropped links (WireGuard/NAT) on idle connections.
DATABASE_KEEPALIVE_DELAY_MS.description: TCP keepalive initial delay for Postgres sockets, in ms. Detects silently dropped links (WireGuard/NAT) on idle connections.

DATABASE_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS.label: Server-side statement_timeout for normal app queries, in ms (0 = off). Long jobs use getLongRunningDb() instead.
DATABASE_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Server-side statement_timeout for normal app queries, in ms (0 = off). Long jobs use getLongRunningDb() instead.

DATABASE_QUERY_TIMEOUT_MS.label: Client-side read timeout per query, in ms (0 = off). Catches black-holed connections where the server's cancel never arrives; the connection is then destroyed. Always kept at least 5 s above the statement timeout.
DATABASE_QUERY_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Client-side read timeout per query, in ms (0 = off). Catches black-holed connections where the server's cancel never arrives; the connection is then destroyed. Always kept at least 5 s above the statement timeout.

DATABASE_IDLE_IN_TRANSACTION_TIMEOUT_MS.label: Server-side idle_in_transaction_session_timeout, in ms (0 = off). Kills sessions that sit in an open transaction (e.g. after the client vanished) so their locks are released.
DATABASE_IDLE_IN_TRANSACTION_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Server-side idle_in_transaction_session_timeout, in ms (0 = off). Kills sessions that sit in an open transaction (e.g. after the client vanished) so their locks are released.

DATABASE_LONG_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS.label: statement_timeout for the separate long-running pool (getLongRunningDb: admin SQL, backfills, maintenance), in ms (0 = off).
DATABASE_LONG_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS.description: statement_timeout for the separate long-running pool (getLongRunningDb: admin SQL, backfills, maintenance), in ms (0 = off).

JWT_SECRET_KEY.label: JWT signing secret - MUST be at least 64 random characters in production. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32
JWT_SECRET_KEY.description: JWT signing secret - MUST be at least 64 random characters in production. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

VIBE_SECRET_KEY.label: Explicit AES-256 encryption key (hex, 64 chars) for sensitive env values at rest. If not set, derived from JWT_SECRET_KEY. Use this in Docker/CI for a fully independent key.
VIBE_SECRET_KEY.description: Explicit AES-256 encryption key (hex, 64 chars) for sensitive env values at rest. If not set, derived from JWT_SECRET_KEY. Use this in Docker/CI for a fully independent key.

VIBE_ADMIN_USER_EMAIL.label: Root admin email. Used for CLI auth, API tool access, and all admin endpoints. Change via the app syncs to DB.
VIBE_ADMIN_USER_EMAIL.description: Root admin email. Used for CLI auth, API tool access, and all admin endpoints. Change via the app syncs to DB.

VIBE_ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD.label: Root admin password. Protects all exposed tools/endpoints. Use a strong password in production! Change via the app syncs to DB.
VIBE_ADMIN_USER_PASSWORD.description: Root admin password. Protects all exposed tools/endpoints. Use a strong password in production! Change via the app syncs to DB.

VIBE_SETUP_STATE.label: First-run setup progress, written by the /setup page: in-progress once the admin login is saved, complete when setup finishes. Unset means the instance was configured without it.
VIBE_SETUP_STATE.description: First-run setup progress, written by the /setup page: in-progress once the admin login is saved, complete when setup finishes. Unset means the instance was configured without it.

VIBE_SERVER_MODE.label: Stable server mode marker for log routing. Auto-detected from argv: atlas-dev (vibe dev), hermes-dev (vibe --hermes dev), hermes-prod (vibe start/build/rebuild), mcp (vibe mcp). Set automatically — no need to configure manually.
VIBE_SERVER_MODE.description: Stable server mode marker for log routing. Auto-detected from argv: atlas-dev (vibe dev), hermes-dev (vibe --hermes dev), hermes-prod (vibe start/build/rebuild), mcp (vibe mcp). Set automatically — no need to configure manually.

VIBE_PID.label: Vibe runtime process ID. Set automatically at startup - no need to configure manually.
VIBE_PID.description: Vibe runtime process ID. Set automatically at startup - no need to configure manually.

VIBE_START_TIME.label: Process start timestamp (ms). Inherited from parent process when available so all sub-processes share the same origin. Set automatically.
VIBE_START_TIME.description: Process start timestamp (ms). Inherited from parent process when available so all sub-processes share the same origin. Set automatically.

NEXT_PUBLIC_VIBE_DEBUG.label: Enable verbose debug logging across the full stack, including the browser client. Two ways to activate: (1) pass -v or --verbose to any vibe command - detected at startup and baked into the build automatically; (2) set NEXT_PUBLIC_VIBE_DEBUG=true in .env for a persistent always-on debug build.
NEXT_PUBLIC_VIBE_DEBUG.description: Enable verbose debug logging across the full stack, including the browser client. Two ways to activate: (1) pass -v or --verbose to any vibe command - detected at startup and baked into the build automatically; (2) set NEXT_PUBLIC_VIBE_DEBUG=true in .env for a persistent always-on debug build.

VIBE_LOG_TARGET.label: Log persistence target. Auto-resolved from VIBE_SERVER_MODE if not set: atlas-dev/hermes-dev/mcp→file, hermes-prod+production→db. Values: 'file' (write to VIBE_LOG_PATH log files), 'db' (errors+warnings to error_logs table only, no file), 'none' (no persistence).
VIBE_LOG_TARGET.description: Log persistence target. Auto-resolved from VIBE_SERVER_MODE if not set: atlas-dev/hermes-dev/mcp→file, hermes-prod+production→db. Values: 'file' (write to VIBE_LOG_PATH log files), 'db' (errors+warnings to error_logs table only, no file), 'none' (no persistence).

VIBE_LOG_PATH.label: Directory for server log files (.atlas.log, .hermes.log, .hermes-dev.log, .vibe-mcp.log). Only used when VIBE_LOG_TARGET=file. Defaults to .tmp. Set to an absolute or relative path to change location.
VIBE_LOG_PATH.description: Directory for server log files (.atlas.log, .hermes.log, .hermes-dev.log, .vibe-mcp.log). Only used when VIBE_LOG_TARGET=file. Defaults to .tmp. Set to an absolute or relative path to change location.

VIBE_LOG_FILE.label: Log filename within VIBE_LOG_PATH. Auto-resolved from VIBE_SERVER_MODE if not set: atlas-dev→.atlas.log, hermes-dev→.hermes-dev.log, hermes-prod→.hermes.log, mcp→.vibe-mcp.log. Override to send all modes to a custom file.
VIBE_LOG_FILE.description: Log filename within VIBE_LOG_PATH. Auto-resolved from VIBE_SERVER_MODE if not set: atlas-dev→.atlas.log, hermes-dev→.hermes-dev.log, hermes-prod→.hermes.log, mcp→.vibe-mcp.log. Override to send all modes to a custom file.

VIBE_LOG_TIMESTAMP.label: Timestamp format in log files. Auto-resolved from VIBE_SERVER_MODE if not set: elapsed (0.123s) for atlas-dev/hermes-dev, iso (HH:MM:SS.mmm) for hermes-prod/mcp. Only used when VIBE_LOG_TARGET=file.
VIBE_LOG_TIMESTAMP.description: Timestamp format in log files. Auto-resolved from VIBE_SERVER_MODE if not set: elapsed (0.123s) for atlas-dev/hermes-dev, iso (HH:MM:SS.mmm) for hermes-prod/mcp. Only used when VIBE_LOG_TARGET=file.

VIBE_COMPUTER_NAME.label: Headless client identity. Overrides the auto-detected name (dev fixed name, or OS hostname in production).
VIBE_COMPUTER_NAME.description: Headless client identity. Overrides the auto-detected name (dev fixed name, or OS hostname in production).

WS_PUBSUB_TYPE.label: WebSocket pub/sub adapter. 'local' for single-instance (default), 'redis' for multi-instance broadcasting.
WS_PUBSUB_TYPE.description: WebSocket pub/sub adapter. 'local' for single-instance (default), 'redis' for multi-instance broadcasting.

REDIS_URL.label: Redis connection URL. Required when WS_PUBSUB_TYPE=redis for cross-instance WebSocket broadcasting.
REDIS_URL.description: Redis connection URL. Required when WS_PUBSUB_TYPE=redis for cross-instance WebSocket broadcasting.

DEV_WATCHER_CONTINUOUS.label: Enable continuous file watching during development. When false (default), generators run once on startup and again when you press 'r' in the terminal - no CPU overhead. When true, generators re-run automatically on every file change. WARNING: continuous mode requires a high-end workstation (64 GB+ RAM, fast multi-core CPU). On less powerful machines it will cause noticeable slowdowns and may make the dev server unresponsive.
DEV_WATCHER_CONTINUOUS.description: Enable continuous file watching during development. When false (default), generators run once on startup and again when you press 'r' in the terminal - no CPU overhead. When true, generators re-run automatically on every file change. WARNING: continuous mode requires a high-end workstation (64 GB+ RAM, fast multi-core CPU). On less powerful machines it will cause noticeable slowdowns and may make the dev server unresponsive.

CRON_SECRET.label: Cron job secret - generate with: openssl rand -hex 32
CRON_SECRET.description: Cron job secret - generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

TSGO_PATH.label: Explicit path to the tsgo binary. Auto-discovered from the project or the checker's own node_modules when unset.
TSGO_PATH.description: Explicit path to the tsgo binary. Auto-discovered from the project or the checker's own node_modules when unset.

DOCKER_BUILD_MEMORY_GB.label: Total memory ceiling for the image-push BuildKit container, in decimal GB. The kernel enforces this across all build steps.
DOCKER_BUILD_MEMORY_GB.description: Total memory ceiling for the image-push BuildKit container, in decimal GB. The kernel enforces this across all build steps.

DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME.label: Registry + image name the prod Docker image is built and pushed to (see: vibe image-push). install-docker.sh pulls this same image on the deploy server instead of building it there.
DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME.description: Registry + image name the prod Docker image is built and pushed to (see: vibe image-push). install-docker.sh pulls this same image on the deploy server instead of building it there.

SSH_SERVER.label: Default SSH target for `vibe image-push` when --sshTarget isn't passed explicitly. Format: user@host or user@host:port.
SSH_SERVER.description: Default SSH target for `vibe image-push` when --sshTarget isn't passed explicitly. Format: user@host or user@host:port.

SSH_SERVER_PWD.label: Password for SSH_SERVER (or an explicit --sshTarget). If unset, `vibe image-push` falls back to the system ssh client (key/agent auth). Only used for the image transfer - never logged.
SSH_SERVER_PWD.description: Password for SSH_SERVER (or an explicit --sshTarget). If unset, `vibe image-push` falls back to the system ssh client (key/agent auth). Only used for the image transfer - never logged.

SSH_SERVER_KEY.label: Private key file (ed25519) for every image-push SSH call to SSH_SERVER and SSH_SERVER2. Tried first; SSH_SERVER_PWD / SSH_SERVER2_PWD stay as the sshpass fallback when the key is refused. A leading ~ expands to the home directory. Unset or missing file = the ssh client's default identities/agent.
SSH_SERVER_KEY.description: Private key file (ed25519) for every image-push SSH call to SSH_SERVER and SSH_SERVER2. Tried first; SSH_SERVER_PWD / SSH_SERVER2_PWD stay as the sshpass fallback when the key is refused. A leading ~ expands to the home directory. Unset or missing file = the ssh client's default identities/agent.

SSH_SERVER2.label: Second HA node. When set, `vibe image-push` rolls it AFTER SSH_SERVER is live and healthy (image under SSH_SERVER2_IMAGE_TAG, Server 1's .env synced, recreate, health-check, auto-rollback). Skipped with --secondary=false or an explicit --sshTarget.
SSH_SERVER2.description: Second HA node. When set, `vibe image-push` rolls it AFTER SSH_SERVER is live and healthy (image under SSH_SERVER2_IMAGE_TAG, Server 1's .env synced, recreate, health-check, auto-rollback). Skipped with --secondary=false or an explicit --sshTarget.

SSH_SERVER2_PWD.label: Password for SSH_SERVER2. If unset, the system ssh client's key/agent auth is used. Never logged.
SSH_SERVER2_PWD.description: Password for SSH_SERVER2. If unset, the system ssh client's key/agent auth is used. Never logged.

SSH_SERVER2_IMAGE_TAG.label: Tag the app image gets on SSH_SERVER2. Never `latest`: Server 2 co-hosts another site that runs :latest. The previous image moves to :<tag>-rollback.
SSH_SERVER2_IMAGE_TAG.description: Tag the app image gets on SSH_SERVER2. Never `latest`: Server 2 co-hosts another site that runs :latest. The previous image moves to :<tag>-rollback.

SSH_SERVER2_DEPLOY_SCRIPT.label: Script run on SSH_SERVER2 after the image is loaded (synced from the deployed commit first). Set to empty string to transfer only.
SSH_SERVER2_DEPLOY_SCRIPT.description: Script run on SSH_SERVER2 after the image is loaded (synced from the deployed commit first). Set to empty string to transfer only.

SSH_SERVER2_RELAY_ADDR.label: Public address of SSH_SERVER2 (host or host:sshPort) for the box-to-box image relay: SSH_SERVER pipes docker save over plain SSH/TCP with its restricted /root/.ssh/ha-image-relay key, which SSH_SERVER2 only accepts from SSH_SERVER's IPs (see ha/README.md). Deliberately NOT the WireGuard IP: multi-GB transfers over WireGuard/UDP trip the provider's DDoS filter, which then drops all UDP between the boxes. Empty = upload to SSH_SERVER2 from this machine instead (much slower).
SSH_SERVER2_RELAY_ADDR.description: Public address of SSH_SERVER2 (host or host:sshPort) for the box-to-box image relay: SSH_SERVER pipes docker save over plain SSH/TCP with its restricted /root/.ssh/ha-image-relay key, which SSH_SERVER2 only accepts from SSH_SERVER's IPs (see ha/README.md). Deliberately NOT the WireGuard IP: multi-GB transfers over WireGuard/UDP trip the provider's DDoS filter, which then drops all UDP between the boxes. Empty = upload to SSH_SERVER2 from this machine instead (much slower).

SSH_SERVER_ENV_PATH.label: Path of the prod .env on SSH_SERVER. image-push copies it to SSH_SERVER2 (server to server through this process, never written locally or logged) so both nodes share identity and keys.
SSH_SERVER_ENV_PATH.description: Path of the prod .env on SSH_SERVER. image-push copies it to SSH_SERVER2 (server to server through this process, never written locally or logged) so both nodes share identity and keys.

SSH_DEPLOY_SCRIPT.label: Script to run on SSH_SERVER after a successful image push to trigger the deploy (docker compose pull + up). Set to empty string to skip.
SSH_DEPLOY_SCRIPT.description: Script to run on SSH_SERVER after a successful image push to trigger the deploy (docker compose pull + up). Set to empty string to skip.

PULUMI_BIN.label: Path to the pulumi binary. Defaults to <HOME>/.pulumi/bin/pulumi.
PULUMI_BIN.description: Path to the pulumi binary. Defaults to <HOME>/.pulumi/bin/pulumi.

PULUMI_PASSPHRASE.label: Passphrase for the Pulumi local-state stack config secrets.
PULUMI_PASSPHRASE.description: Passphrase for the Pulumi local-state stack config secrets.

SNYK_TOKEN.label: Snyk API token. Enables vulnerability scanning during release.
SNYK_TOKEN.description: Snyk API token. Enables vulnerability scanning during release.

SNYK_ORG_KEY.label: Snyk organization key used for `snyk monitor` during release.
SNYK_ORG_KEY.description: Snyk organization key used for `snyk monitor` during release.

GITHUB_TOKEN.label: GitHub token used to create/update the weekly dependency-update PR. Set automatically in GitHub Actions.
GITHUB_TOKEN.description: GitHub token used to create/update the weekly dependency-update PR. Set automatically in GitHub Actions.

NEXT_PUBLIC_PROJECT_URL.description: Project URL - defaults to https://unbottled.ai. Override to use your own domain.

title: Vytvoriť tajný kľúč
description: Vygenerujte kryptograficky bezpečný náhodný kľúč so 64 hexadecimálnymi znakmi

title: Počkať na úlohu
description: Počká na spustenú úlohu na pozadí. Ak je hotová, výsledok vráti ihneď. Inak pozastaví prenos odpovede AI, kým sa úloha nedokončí.

title: Zrušiť volanie nástroja
description: Preruší jedno prebiehajúce volanie nástroja podľa callId. Výsledkom volania bude chyba. Krok a ostatné súbežné volania pokračujú.

title: Odpojiť volanie nástroja
description: Odpojí prebiehajúce volanie nástroja podľa callId. Volanie sa dokončí na pozadí, jeho výsledok sa zahodí a aktuálny krok môže hneď pokračovať. Ak potrebujete výsledok, použite resume-when-done.

title: Presunúť volanie nástroja na pozadie
description: Podľa callId nechá prebiehajúce volanie dokončiť na pozadí. Aktuálny krok sa ukončí. Keď je výsledok pripravený, vlákno sa obnoví aj s výsledkom.

title: Hlásenie o úlohe
description: Prijme výsledky vykonania úloh zo vzdialených inštancií.

title: Spustiť nástroj
description: Spustí registrovaný koncový bod podľa názvu nástroja a jeho vstupných parametrov. Cieľový koncový bod overuje prístup podľa vlastných pravidiel. Tento koncový bod sprostredkuje volania z MCP, agentov AI a automatizácií.

toolName.label: Názov nástroja
toolName.description: Názov alebo alias registrovaného nástroja, napríklad vibe_agent_skills_GET. Dostupné nástroje zobrazíte pomocou tool-help.

input.label: Vstup
input.description: Vstupné parametre nástroja ako objekt JSON. Parametre cesty URL, napríklad id, sa z objektu načítajú automaticky.

instanceId.label: ID inštancie
instanceId.description: Nepovinné ID vzdialenej inštancie. Ak ho zadáte, na vzdialenej inštancii sa vytvorí asynchrónna úloha. Výsledok bude {taskId, status:"pending"}.

callbackMode.label: Režim spätného volania
callbackMode.description: 'wait': vykoná nástroj synchrónne a vráti výsledok priamo (predvolené). 'detach': spustí nástroj na pozadí a hneď vráti {taskId}. Neskôr môžete použiť await-task. 'wakeUp': spustí nástroj na pozadí a keď je výsledok hotový, automaticky ho vloží do vlákna. Pri tomto režime nevolajte await-task. 'endLoop': vykoná nástroj a vráti výsledok, no po tejto dávke zastaví cyklus nástrojov. Ďalšie volania v tomto kroku nespustí, súbežné volania v rovnakej dávke však dobehnú. 'approve': pred vykonaním počká na potvrdenie používateľa.

result.label: Výsledok z cieľového koncového bodu. Pri zlyhaní pole chýba a odpoveď obsahuje chybu.

title: Pomocník pre nástroje
description: Vyhľadajte dostupné nástroje. Volanie bez parametrov zobrazí všetky nástroje a kategórie. Parametrom query vyhľadáte podľa názvu, popisu alebo aliasu. Parametrom toolName získate úplnú schému parametrov. Parametrom category vyberiete kategóriu. Stránkovanie nastavíte pomocou page a pageSize. Predvolená veľkosť stránky pre AI a MCP je 100.

query.label: Vyhľadávací výraz (voliteľný)
query.description: Vyhľadajte nástroje podľa kľúčových slov. Výsledok musí obsahovať všetky slová oddelené medzerou. Vyhľadávanie nerozlišuje veľké a malé písmená a zahŕňa názvy, aliasy, popisy a značky. Presná zhoda názvu alebo aliasu má prednosť a zobrazí podrobnosti. Bez výrazu sa zobrazia všetky nástroje.
query.placeholder: Napríklad načítanie adresy URL, tvorba obrázkov, pamäť…

category.label: Filter kategórie
category.description: Filtrujte podľa názvu kategórie alebo podkategórie. Zadajte kľúč nadradenej kategórie, napríklad ai, alebo názov podkategórie, napríklad Search. Na veľkosti písmen nezáleží. Bez filtra sa zobrazia všetky kategórie.

subCategory.label: Filter kategórie
subCategory.description: Filtrujte podľa názvu kategórie alebo podkategórie. Zadajte kľúč nadradenej kategórie, napríklad ai, alebo názov podkategórie, napríklad Search. Na veľkosti písmen nezáleží. Bez filtra sa zobrazia všetky kategórie.

toolName.label: Názov nástroja na zobrazenie podrobností
toolName.description: Získajte úplnú schému parametrov podľa presného toolName, napríklad agent_search_brave_GET, alebo aliasu. Pred volaním neznámeho nástroja si schému skontrolujte.

page.label: Strana
page.description: Číslo strany výsledkov. Predvolená hodnota je 1.

pageSize.label: Počet výsledkov na strane
pageSize.description: Počet výsledkov na strane. Predvolená hodnota je 100 v AI a MCP a 800 na webe a v CLI. Najviac 1 000.

includeProdOnly.label: Zahrnúť nástroje určené iba pre produkciu
includeProdOnly.description: Po zapnutí sa zobrazia aj nástroje označené ako dostupné iba v produkcii. Túto voľbu môžu použiť iba správcovia. Hodnota all vo filtri platformy zobrazí nástroje naprieč platformami.

viewAsRole.label: Zobraziť ako používateľská rola
viewAsRole.description: Skontrolujte, ktoré nástroje môže zobraziť vybraná rola. Túto voľbu môžu použiť iba správcovia.

instanceId.label: ID inštancie
instanceId.description: Voliteľne zobrazte iba nástroje určitej vzdialenej inštancie. Bez tejto hodnoty sa prehľadajú miestne nástroje.

statsFilter.label: Filter nástrojov
